caption: Markwayne Mullin, Secretary of Homeland Security v. Friends of the Ruidosa Church
author: Per Curiam
holding: The District Court lacked jurisdiction under §102(c)(2)(A) of the Illegal Immigration Reform and Immigrant Responsibility Act of 1996 to adjudicate respondents’ claim that the Secretary of Homeland Security exceeded his statutory authority in waiving legal requirements for border-barrier construction, because invocation of the major-questions doctrine does not transform a statutory claim into a constitutional one.
